name: wl_Stonehenge
prompt: Subject: Stonehenge, a compact ring of chunky grey standing stones with lintels, a few fallen stones, small grass tufts between them.
style: Style: a very simple chunky low-poly game icon in the style of The Battle of Polytopia. Minimal geometry: the fewest large flat facets that still read clearly, like a toy made of about 20 to 40 polygons. Two tones per color only (lit side and shadow side), light from the upper left. No small details, no ornaments, no faces, no textures, no gradients, no outlines, no text, no ground plane, no drop shadow. Bold simple silhouette that reads at 24 pixels. Palette: grass green #8BD14F, sky blue #5CC8FF, sand #E8D27A, terracotta #D9774B, stone #C3CAD4, wood #8A5A33, gold #FFC93C, cream #F4ECD9. Three-quarter isometric view matching a tile-based strategy map seen from above at 45 degrees, object centered and filling about 80 percent of the frame, no ground tile, no base plate. Background: solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF filling the whole canvas edge to edge. The object must not contain any magenta or pink.

name: ws_Stonehenge
prompt: Subject: Stonehenge standing on a floating grassy hexagonal island with brown earth sides, the ring of standing stones catching the sunrise, a few low-poly trees and a winding path on the island, small birds in the sky.
style: Style: a polished low-poly 3D diorama illustration in the spirit of The Battle of Polytopia but richer and more detailed, crisp flat-shaded facets, warm golden-hour light from the upper left, soft volumetric light rays, saturated but harmonious palette (grass #8BD14F, sky blues, warm sand, stone grays, gold #FFC93C). No text, no UI, no border, no people. Vertical portrait composition for a phone screen, the subject in the middle third, generous sky above and soft cloud sea below.
